title: Profile-driven KV-aware batching advisor and safe rollout
creator: Anika Rao
description:
Goal: Build a continuous recommendation engine that suggests batching and KV-caching profile changes per workload class, validates them in shadow/canary, and applies them with an automated safe-rollback path. This ticket covers the advisor heuristics, profiling pipeline, rollout controller integration, and the rollback guard implementation.

Context: Current autotune work produces batch size suggestions but does not account for KV cache effectiveness, cold-start prefix reuse, or workload temporal shifts. Teams have requested a single advisor that correlates token-cost deltas with cache-hit signals and latency SLO risk, and can safely propose/auto-apply parameter changes (batch size, max_concat, kv_window_size, prefix_cache_ttl) without manual intervention for low-risk workloads.

Non-goals: This ticket does not implement cross-region routing or RBAC for applying changes to customer-dedicated clusters (those are follow-ups). It also does not change kernel selection heuristics; the advisor only suggests runtime config knobs that the serving layer already supports.
acceptance_criteria: Advisor generates workload-level suggestions with confidence score >= 0.7 for at least 80% of sampled workloads
Telemetry exposes per-suggestion signals: expected token-savings, estimated latency regression probability, kv-hit delta, and fallback model variant mapping
Rollout controller can execute a canary applying suggestion to 5% traffic with automated health evaluation and auto-rollback within 10 minutes on SLO or error anomalies
Manual review mode available: suggestions appear in Console with diff, expected impact, and a single-click apply/rollback
End-to-end test between profiler -> advisor -> rollout controller covered by CI and a staged canary on staging cluster
implementation_notes: Profiling: extend workload-snapshotter to capture KV prefix reuse histogram, per-session KV hit-rate, and median output length per route
Features: construct feature vector for advisor: qps, p50/p95 latency, median prompt length, kv_hit_rate, prefix_reuse_ratio, percent_short_responses (<32 tokens), recent traffic volatility
Heuristics: primary rule set - increase microbatch_max if kv_hit_rate >= 0.6 AND p95_latency headroom >= 30ms AND cost-savings estimated > 10%
Safety checks: require top-2 compatible fallback model variants and model-variant mapping to be pre-validated before apply
Continuous annealing: use an exponential backoff annealer that increases apply intensity (traffic %) only while telemetry drift stays within thresholds
Rollback: define immediate rollback triggers: error-rate increase > 50% relative, p95 latency regression > 40% absolute vs baseline, or user-facing error spikes observed in route traces
Instrumentation: add span tags for suggestion_id and rollout_id on serving traces to correlate requests with applied config
Data retention: keep profiling snapshots for 30 days and suggestion history for 90 days for analysis and audits
rollout_plan: 1) Shadow experiments: run advisor suggestions in shadow mode for 48-72h across 200 sampled workloads to validate predicted token savings and kv-hit deltas. 2) Staging canary: apply to staging cluster on 10% of traffic for 3h; monitor telemetry and manual sign-off. 3) Production gradual: 1% -> 5% -> 15% over 4 hours with automated checks at each step. 4) Auto-rollback window: if any trigger fires, controller immediately rolls back and notifies on-call and PM. 5) Post-rollout: run cost/latency regression job and persist results to Dashboard for 7 days.
